metadata.description: Agent Skills for the Riksarkivet rask HTR platform — language/toolchain conventions (Python, TypeScript, FastAPI, Dagger, Docker, OTel, Zensical, pytest) plus project-specific architecture, services-fleet, HTR pipeline, and orchestrator skills. Granular: install one skill at a time with /plugin install <name>@AI-Riksarkivet/ra-skills.

plugins.name: writing-python
plugins.description: Idiomatic Python 3.14+ — type safety, Pydantic-first patterns, error handling, config, CLI.

plugins.name: writing-typescript
plugins.description: Idiomatic TypeScript for the SvelteKit frontend + component lib — strict typing, Result types, Bun/Vite/Vitest.

plugins.name: shadcn-svelte
plugins.description: shadcn-svelte components + CLI: add/update/fix components, composition, forms, icons, styling, components.json (official skill from huntabyte/shadcn-svelte).

plugins.name: micro-frontends
plugins.description: Composing one UI from independently deployed frontends owned by separate teams: build-time / zones / server-side / client-side-runtime composition, Module Federation, single-spa, web components, cross-app communication, and when-to-use tradeoffs.

plugins.name: playwright-cli
plugins.description: Drive a browser + author Playwright tests from the terminal via playwright-cli (Playwright MCP): navigate/click/fill/snapshot/eval, test generation, request mocking, tracing, storage-state, video. Official skill from @playwright/cli (Apache-2.0, Microsoft).

plugins.name: architecture-diagram
plugins.description: Architecture diagrams for the rask platform as a single self-contained HTML file — interactive click-through flows (animated steps, mode toggles, side panel, drag) OR static export-ready topology snapshots with cloud/cluster/security-group/zone boundaries; both with built-in PNG/PDF/clipboard export. Biased to the RA stack: Ray, Argo Workflows, GitOps, Kubernetes, NATS JetStream, Dapr, Redis, FastAPI, SvelteKit, turborepo, micro-frontends, HF Hub, OpenTelemetry, the HTR pipeline.

plugins.name: gsap
plugins.description: GSAP (GreenSock) animation for the SvelteKit frontend — biased to SvelteKit 2 + Svelte 5 (runes): tweens, timelines, ScrollTrigger (scroll reveals, parallax, pinning, scrub), and the now-free plugins (SplitText, Flip, Draggable, MorphSVG, ScrollSmoother). Svelte-first integration via the {@attach} pattern, gsap.context()/matchMedia() cleanup, SSR-safe setup, and Lenis smooth scroll, with copy-paste templates ($lib/gsap.ts, attachment factories, a golden-path component, a root +layout.svelte) and per-topic references. Original work; credits the official GreenSock gsap-skills (MIT).

plugins.name: fastapi
plugins.description: FastAPI + Pydantic production patterns: async, dependency injection, repositories, services, tests.

plugins.name: testing-python
plugins.description: pytest for the rask suite — importlib import-mode, explicit testpaths, the slow marker, async + respx HTTP mocking.

plugins.name: python-infrastructure
plugins.description: System-reliability Python: NATS JetStream jobs, Dapr workflows, tenacity retries, Redis cache, OTLP.

plugins.name: otel
plugins.description: OpenTelemetry for Python services — SDK setup, spans/metrics/logs, semantic conventions, the Collector pipeline.

plugins.name: dagger
plugins.description: Dagger modules/functions in Go for container builds and CI/CD as typed, composable pipelines.

plugins.name: dockerfile
plugins.description: Production dockerfiles — multi-stage discipline, BuildKit cache mounts, hadolint, the .docker build-context contract.

plugins.name: turborepo
plugins.description: Turborepo monorepo build system — turbo.json task pipelines, caching/remote cache, --filter/--affected, CI optimization, boundaries.

plugins.name: zensical-setup
plugins.description: Set up and configure Zensical (zensical.toml): palette, nav, theme features, mkdocstrings, GitHub Pages deploy.

plugins.name: zensical-authoring
plugins.description: Author Zensical docs: admonitions, superfences/mermaid, tabbed blocks, tasklists, grids, icons, front matter.
